decisive_items: SARS-CoV-2 RNA was detected on nasopharyngeal swab by RT-PCR on presentation
response.rationale: Fever, conjunctivitis, elevated inflammatory markers, and confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection meet MIS-C criteria; the cerebral stenoses and brain lesions are neurological complications of the systemic inflammatory process, not a primary vasculitis or AHLE.

rejected.why: CTA stenoses are compelling but vasculitis profile is negative and systemic mucocutaneous/inflammatory features are better explained by MIS-C.
Brain CT lesions are nonspecific and no hemorrhage is described; lacks systemic MIS-C features.
Same as R2; hemorrhagic leukoencephalitis is not supported by imaging or systemic picture.
Too nonspecific; does not capture the multisystem inflammatory syndrome with COVID-19.
Descriptive syndrome only; does not address fever, conjunctivitis, or inflammatory markers.
